rule CobaltStrike_Beacon_Dynamic_Loader {
    meta:
        description = "Detects runtime loading of Cobalt Strike beacons via rundll32"
        author = "SOC_Team"
        reference = "MITRE ATT&CK T1218.011"
        tlp = "amber"
    strings:
        $x64_header = { 4D 5A 90 00 03 00 00 00 04 00 00 00 FF FF } // Standard PE header
        $reflective_loader = "ReflectiveLoader" wide ascii
        $config_indicators = "beacon\x00\x00\x00" wide
    condition:
        uint16(0) == 0x5A4D and $x64_header at 0 and $reflective_loader and $config_indicators
}
